title: fix(router): merge results of intialUiState with RouteState
body:

**Summary**

<!--

  What existing problem does the pull request solve?
  Are there any linked issues?

Initial UI State can be used to set a default refinement, e.g. an item in a refinement list to be checked. This can be done in parallel to routing, and should merge per index.



related to #4393, but not fixing it, since they want intial UI State to be _written_ to the router too, which probably shouldn't be done, since that will cause a navigation as an effect of loading


also related to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/discussions/4455
